audience: restaurant and shop managers who run their point of sale in Dotypos

useCases.title: Review the sales of one business day
useCases.text: List the branches, then get the sales report of one branch for one business day. It shows sales, cancels, revenue by payment type, discounts and cash in and out.

useCases.title: Find products running low on stock
useCases.text: List the warehouses, then list the stock levels with a maximum quantity to find products running low. Use the result to decide what to reorder.

useCases.title: Check unpaid orders for a period
useCases.text: List the orders of a period and filter for unpaid ones, newest first. Open one order to see its totals, customer, table and notes.

useCases.title: Check the reservations for an evening
useCases.text: List the reservations in a time window, for one branch or customer. Each one shows its table, seats and status: new, confirmed or cancelled.

useCases.title: Look up a product and what sold
useCases.text: Search the catalog by name, EAN or PLU code and open one product to read its prices with and without VAT. List sold items for a time range to see what sold in that period.

useCases.title: Add a customer or correct a product
useCases.text: Create a customer from a guest's details, or change a customer's contact data. Change a product's name, net price, description or visibility.
